options.label: Force-push instead of delete-and-recreate (Recommended)
options.description: I disable FF-public branch protection, mirror-clone the renamed FF, force-push main from the clean HEAD 27b5caec, re-enable branch protection. options.label: You delete FamilyFund-public via the web UI
options.description: Settings → Danger Zone on github.com. I dispatch worker starting at Step 2 (create fresh + push + harden). Same end-state as option 2 without the gh scope change.
